name: Harness fixture creatures attack a Witch Doctor and record an allowed cast refusal
contract: ADR 1027 (provisional) adds creature_attack (a fixture creature set aggressive melees a player, or stops),
allowed_refusal on a creature cast (the step passes when the cast is refused with exactly that
SpellCastResult) and creature_cast_result (the result of a creature's last cast of a spell, -1 before any).
Eye of Kimbul 802707 refuses a stealth spell of its carrier with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE 22
(AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp OnSpellCheckCast, every caster, triggered or not): unmarked, the dummy
stealths (result 0); marked, the same triggered cast is refused (22) and no aura lands. A second creature 36
melees the doctor: at least 2 swings in 6000 ms (2000 ms swing timer), none in 6000 ms after it stops.
